changes: Added signed review_run_start records; bound reviewer findings and passes to reviewRunId; tightened signature verification so reviewRunId records cannot fall back to legacy signatures; constrained forceReviewer to supported lanes; updated prompts, dispatch, anti-stall guidance, runtime reviewer contract, and process-fact registry tests.
usage: Reviewers now run review_run_start first, copy the returned reviewRunId, and include it in review_pass_set or finding_add. Maintainers use reviewer_list/session_brief to see pending lanes and validate gates as usual.
expectedOutcome: A reviewer cannot satisfy REVIEW with prompt-only claims, stale context, wrong lane, missing reviewRunId, or a legacy-signed record retrofitted with a fresh run id.
actualTranscript: build passed; process-fact contract passed; anti-stall guardrails passed; flow stability smoke passed; field regression CLI smoke passed; review pass/discard smoke passed; runtime reviewer contract passed; validate passed with 13/13 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: No mismatch. The only advisory is expected: global fallback koala points at main while this story is still in a worktree.
pitfalls: Do not run build concurrently with runtime CLI contract tests because dist can be observed mid-write; do not parallelize finding_resolve on the same findings file because last writer can overwrite status changes.
